jsonld.name: AI大模型API成本计算器
jsonld.description: 按厂商公开价目估算大模型 API 月成本，支持错峰低谷价与缓存命中率加权。

acceptedAnswer.text: 月成本 = 日均调用次数 × 30 ×（单次输入Token数 ÷ 100万 × 输入有效单价 + 单次输出Token数 ÷ 100万 × 输出单价）。输入有效单价按缓存命中率加权：命中率 × 缓存命中价 +（1 - 命中率）× 未命中价；未公开缓存价的模型直接按未命中价计。

mainEntity.name: DeepSeek 低谷价什么时候适用？

acceptedAnswer.text: DeepSeek 采用分时段定价，高峰时段为工作日 9:00-12:00 与 14:00-18:00，其余时段（夜间、凌晨、节假日全天）适用低谷价。低谷价约为高峰价的一半，把批量任务调度到低谷时段即可直接降本。

mainEntity.name: 缓存命中率是什么意思？

acceptedAnswer.text: 缓存命中率指请求中命中上下文缓存的输入 Token 比例。命中部分按远低于标准价的缓存价计费，未命中部分按标准输入价计费。保持稳定的Prompt前缀（如固定系统提示词）可显著提高命中率，从而降低输入成本。

acceptedAnswer.text: Monthly cost = calls per day × 30 × (input tokens ÷ 1,000,000 × effective input price + output tokens ÷ 1,000,000 × output price). The effective input price is weighted by cache hit rate: hit rate × cache-hit price + (1 − hit rate) × standard price. Models without a published cache price are billed at the standard input price.

mainEntity.name: When do DeepSeek off-peak rates apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: DeepSeek uses time-based pricing. Peak hours are weekdays 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00; all other times (nights, early mornings, weekends and public holidays) use the off-peak rate, which is about half the peak rate. Scheduling batch jobs off-peak directly reduces cost.

mainEntity.name: What does cache hit rate mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cache hit rate is the share of input tokens that hit the context cache. Hit tokens are billed at a much lower cache-hit price; the rest are billed at the standard input price. Keeping a stable prompt prefix (such as a fixed system prompt) raises the hit rate and lowers input cost.
